And do the thermal paste cleanup and reapplication again when putting the CPU back in its original board.

WPG doesn' have the thermal paste for that. The only thermal paste available is for the 3D printer and that is completely useless with CPU's, because of the temperature range these pastes need to work with. For a 3D printer those temps are double.
